name: Patio
description:
Helo Patio saunas take the popular "Panel-Built" sauna series a step further by offering the sauna as an outdoor ready unit.
Portability, exceptional quality and easy installation make these a sauna lover's dream. All Patio saunas come with pre-built panels designed to be jointed together ready for power hook-up in a few hours. Our Patio saunas come in four sizes and feature an optional shingled or metal sheeting modular roof kit that lets you decide what roofing material you would like.
